span.p: Request Lifecycle — Steps 7-12: Buffer Cache to Response

span.div:
Step 10: WAL Write (for write queries)
[Write-Ahead Log (PostgreSQL WAL)]
──> 1. Append transaction to WAL buffer
2. WAL writer flushes to disk
3. fsync() call (kernel page cache flush)
4. Return success to client
Latency: 0.5-5ms (WAL write to NVMe)
2-10ms (WAL write to EBS)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Step 11: Response Encoding
[Response Encoding (PostgreSQL)]
──> 1. Format result rows as protocol buffer
2. Copy to socket send buffer
3. Trigger TCP send
Latency: 1-10 microseconds per row

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Step 12: Network Send
[NIC Transmit]
──> 1. TCP segmentation / GSO
2. Checksum offload (checksum to NIC)
3. DMA from kernel buffer to NIC
Latency: 0.5-2 microseconds

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
End-to-end latency breakdown (read, cache HIT):
Network receive: ~3 microseconds
TCP/IP processing: ~10 microseconds
Query parsing: ~5 microseconds
Plan + locks: ~15 microseconds
Buffer cache read: ~100 microseconds
Data processing: ~10 microseconds
Response send: ~5 microseconds
─────────────────────────────────────────
Total: ~150 microseconds

span.div:
Step 7: Buffer Cache Lookup
[PostgreSQL shared_buffers (kernel + PG)]
──> Check shared_buffers for data pages
Cache HIT: read from RAM (0.1ms)
Cache MISS: schedule disk I/O (10ms)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Step 8: Data Page Read (on cache miss)
[Block Layer (blk-mq)] ──>
[NVMe Driver + NVMe Device]
──> 1. Page cache check (kernel)
2. If also miss in page cache:
request goes to NVMe driver
3. DMA transfer from NVMe to RAM
4. PG shared_buffers populated
Latency: 10-100 microseconds (NVMe)
>1ms (EBS — network RTT)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Step 9: Data Processing
[Query Executor (PostgreSQL)]
──> 1. Process qualifying rows
2. Apply WHERE clause filter
3. Apply ORDER BY / GROUP BY
4. Join rows (nested loop / hash / merge)
Latency: 10 nanoseconds per row (filter)
1-100 microseconds per page (join)
